title: qa-strategist agent output
description: Machine-readable summary returned by the qa-strategist agent after a test-coverage gap analysis. Mirrors the Output Format section of agents/qa-strategist.md.

verdict.description: Overall disposition: PROCEED = adequate coverage; PROCEED_WITH_FOLLOWUPS = LOW/MEDIUM gaps only; FIX_REQUIRED = HIGH coverage gap that risks production silent failure; BLOCKED = cannot complete analysis.

report_path.description: Relative path to the human-readable gap report written to .orchestrator/audits/.

redundancy_counts.description: Over-testing findings — the symmetric counterpart to `gap_counts`. A high count here calls for consolidation/deletion, never for writing more tests.

duplicate.description: Tests exercising the same branch with equivalent inputs; all but one can be deleted without losing catch-power.

worthless.description: Tests that still pass when the implementation body is replaced with `throw new Error()` — tautological computations, assert-nothing bodies, overly-generous assertions.

framework_only.description: Tests verifying the language, the framework, or the presence of a string in a document rather than this repo's behaviour.

test_to_src_ratio.description: Test LOC divided by source LOC over the reviewed scope. A signal, not a verdict — interpret only alongside `redundancy_counts`.

blockers.description: Free-text blocker descriptions; empty array when verdict is not BLOCKED.
